d: Norway... a country... counted among the most beautiful and happy countries in the world... where fjords, lakes, and snow-capped mountains are visible at every turn... known for views like the Northern Lights and the Midnight Sun... Where cities like Oslo, Bergen, and Tromse are a blend of modernity and tradition... and where the history of the seafaring Vikings is also found... that country... is Norway... about which there is a lot that you too must know, so come with us on a journey to Norway, on the Infinity Stream...
